en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the richly carved Baroque interior of a wooden church. In the foreground is an ornate pulpit covered with dense floral and figurative woodcarving, standing on a sculpted base. Above hangs an elaborately carved sounding board or canopy, and to the right another highly decorated structure, likely part of the altar or a similar liturgical fitting. The setting has log walls and a simple balustrade around the chancel. Text printed at the bottom identifies the location and photographer.
